title: PointObservation
description: One sampled point from the spatial sampling tool. §15.1, §17.1, §37.2. RECONSTRUCTED from the architecture doc — diff against the actual locked PointObservation.json before use. Canonical convention: point_id = P0-P8 for the local grid, never compass letters.

point_id.description: Local grid: P0 (centre) - P8. Regional scan: R0001... Route corridor cells: C0001..., waypoints: W0001... Historical: reuses fixed local/regional IDs. §17.1

bearing_deg.description: Bearing from the sampling centre. Null for the centre point itself (P0).

distance_km.description: Distance from the sampling centre (P0) or route origin, in km. 0 for the centre point.

point_status.description: applicable/not_applicable set by the sampling tool (§15.1). prohibited is added later once GIS constraints are evaluated (§37.2, §59).
